title: Furnace on, but no heat? (whiteboard diagram demo)
audience: Homeowners with a gas or electric furnace, seeing this on Instagram or Facebook Reels on the first cold weeks of fall

scenes.text: Furnace running, but the house is still cold? Check this first.
Here is a two minute check. Start at the thermostat. Is it set to heat? If not, switch it. If it is, look at the filter. Dirty? Replace it. Clean, and still cold? Call a pro.

visual.title: Furnace check

flowchart TD
